title: Apply regenerated fees
summary: Adds an apply step that writes regenerated fee rows, plus the type and mills helper it needs.

src/billing/types.ts.what: Adds Insertion, the row the apply step writes.

outline.Insertion: A fee plus why it is being inserted.

src/billing/mills.ts.what: Adds millsToDecimal, the reverse of toMills, so amounts are written back exactly.

src/billing/apply.ts.what: New. Turns insertions into fee rows.

src/api/route.ts.what: New entry point that wraps fees as insertions and applies them.

outline.handle: Marks every fee as a regeneration.

src/api/legacy.ts.what: Removed; the new route replaces it.

src/util/fmt.ts.what: Renamed from format.ts; no code change.

links.reason: apply consumes the new Insertion type.

dropped.why: Type-only import of the unchanged Fee type.

context.what: Another writer of fee rows; apply must produce the same shape.

context_links.reason: Both write fee rows, so apply mirrors writeFee's fields.
